niche.habitat: Upper haze layer (15-25 km altitude), drifting on thermal tides
niche.diet: Electrostatically charged tholin particulates, dissolved ammonia vapor
niche.active: Perpetual; pulses rhythmically to regulate buoyancy

body: Enormous gas-filled hydrocarbon bladder, suspended tethers of woven keratin-analogue, skin laminated with conductive Fe-Ni dust

links: Physical root: High surface pressure and gravity

skill.effect: When falling, the creature drifts gently downward like a feather, landing softly without injury.

chains.weakness: Vulnerable to puncture weapons; sudden pressure drops cause explosive decompression.

journal.en: A living balloon drinking the sky's grey rain.

plausibility.summary: Treat the bladder as a hydrogen-dominated lift envelope with hydrocarbon/polymer lamination as the structural skin; keep the creature strictly in the upper haze where scale height improves the volume-to-mass tradeoff.
fixes: Treat the bladder as a hydrogen-dominated lift envelope with hydrocarbon/polymer lamination as the structural skin; keep the creature strictly in the upper haze where scale height improves the volume-to-mass tradeoff.

analogues.organism: Deep-sea squid neutral buoyancy via ammonia-rich coelomic fluid (not a gas balloon); spider juvenile ballooning on silk—mechanism differs but selects on aerial dispersal/filter niches
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

chains.trait: Conductive Fe-Ni dust lamination in skin
links: Atmospheric friction in opaque haze generates high voltage
Conductive metal prevents arc damage and discharges enemies
Physical root: Reducing atmosphere and photochemical haze

skill.effect: Striking the creature sends a sharp electric jolt back into the attacker, while its conductive skin deflects heavy blows.

chains.weakness: Attracted to strong magnetic fields; EMP-like pulses stun and discharge skin.

plausibility.summary: Replace ‘high-voltage arc armor’ with weak pulsed shocks/corona at close range; keep Fe–Ni lamination for charge spreading and self-protection during drift through charged tholin aerosols.
fixes: Replace ‘high-voltage arc armor’ with weak pulsed shocks/corona at close range; keep Fe–Ni lamination for charge spreading and self-protection during drift through charged tholin aerosols.

analogues.organism: Electric ray (Torpediniformes) and electric eel (Electrophorus) discharge; chiton (Acanthopleura) magnetite-reinforced teeth for mineralized conduction paths
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

links: Physical root: Ammonia-tholin haze and biochemistry

skill.effect: The creature anchors a tethered siphon that steadily drains energy from a nearby target, replenishing its own form.

chains.weakness: Tethers can be snagged on terrain or entangled; immobilized Nubezón cannot feed.

journal.en: Drifting orchards of glass and poison.

plausibility.summary: F8 photochemical tholins and F6 NH₃ vapor provide a spatially concentrated aerial organic flux; sticky or charged aerosols can be harvested by elongated filter tethers without vision. At 330 K (F7), enzymatic handling of NH₃ and reduced organics aligns with F18 assimilation paths. Tether entanglement risk in gust shear is an honest weakness.
fixes: F8 photochemical tholins and F6 NH₃ vapor provide a spatially concentrated aerial organic flux; sticky or charged aerosols can be harvested by elongated filter tethers without vision. At 330 K (F7), enzymatic handling of NH₃ and reduced organics aligns with F18 assimilation paths. Tether entanglement risk in gust shear is an honest weakness.

analogues.organism: Appendicularian ‘larvacean house’ aerosol/filter feeding; baleen whale skim filtering—convergent on dilute suspended particles
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

links: Dense air propagates low frequencies far
Used for mate attraction and territory
Physical root: Sound speed and propagation in dense atmosphere

skill.effect: A deep resonant pulse echoes outward, drawing a companion from the distance while strongly bolstering the resilience of nearby allies.

chains.weakness: High-frequency whistles disrupt resonance; silence zones negate skill range.
observe: Throat sac pulses with blue bioluminescence

plausibility.summary: Drop visible bioluminescence; describe the sac as an inflatable resonator with vascular IR flushing (cf. F19) for close-range display, and keep long-range pairing on low-frequency throbs only.

relations.note: (council kind 'Resource Provider') Nubezón molted carapace flakes drift down; Eridians scavenge them for carapace repair.

temperament: Placid drifter; defensive via high-voltage arc and acoustic thrumming
secrets: Nubezón bladder gas can be condensed into a volatile fuel mixture.
Conductive skin scrapings craft high-efficiency insulation for high-pressure gear.
moments: A Nubezón breaches the haze layer; its metallic skin catches the faint IR glow of the star, turning it into a silent, glowing leviathan that arcs lightning across the dark.

journal.en: The sky does not fall; it hovers.
We listen for the drum that holds the weight of worlds.
